item.title: Box of Miscellaneous Items
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: no

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama/Emotional i guess

Page Layout (Optional): Pictures, story, tabs for testing and the like.

Elevator Pitch: Additional Notes: Note any concerns or particular areas of assistance you would like reviewers to focus on.I have an idea, but not sure how good it is so I want some advice. The skip is legit a cardboard box of random items. Every person swears the box is anomalous. But nothing happens, no sensor readings, no properties, nothing. It is, for all purposes, a random box with random goods inside. Just a plain old box. Yet, the Foundation- in all their wisdom and favor- cannot accept that they might have gotten one wrong. So its classified as either keter since the foundation starts associating random mundane everyday bad luck with it just to make some sense of it.

Pretty much, I want to tell this story of the Foundation being so zealous and confident that they cannot accept that they made a single mistake somewhere and have been wasting time on an ordinary box.

Central Narrative: Its going to describe the long and turtourus experience of many researchers attempting to prove that this box is anomalous. From scanners to shoving the box in with other skips, to eventual word of mouth fear of the box and its supposed properties. Eventually with high clearance the story will be shown that more and more tests came back negative, until only the O-5 council access shows it is a normal box but the council cannot admit it was a mistake.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I want to tell the story not of the Foundation being perfect, but rather as a flawed machine that thinks its perfect. Of thinking they cannot even make a single mistake.

item.title: A Canary In The Coal Mine
item.description: The story of researchers researching other researchers. When the lines between 'tester' and 'testee' become blurred.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama

Page Layout (Optional): It will begin with a standard SCP article structure, followed by a series of experiment logs, journal extracts and Foundation documents explaining the story of the discovery of the subject.

Elevator Pitch: One day a researcher discovers a strange correlation between co-worker drinking a specific brand of soda and disasters/containment breaches occuring to their projects which he is certain is a viable "warning-light" to help contain dangerous SCPs.

Central Narrative: An anonomous researcher in one of the foundation sites has been secretly classified as a thaumiel class SCP, used as an early warning system for potential disasters that may befall foundation projects. Should this researcher drink a can of soda of a brand they typically claim to hate, it is a sign that a project which the researcher is assigned to will have a some form of disaster occur to it.

One observant co-worker, Dr. Gables, notices this trend and begins documenting it. What follows is a series of test logs and journal extracts of Dr. Gables investigating this anomouly and putting the paperwork in to give the researcher an official SCP designation. As the logs go on, experiments ramp up and start getting strange. By the time Dr. Gables has orchestrated an entire breach event resulting in multiple deaths, we realise that he had been operating without foundation clearance the entire time.

He uses an edited version of his obervations (with his involvment having been removed) to get the researcher an official SCP designation. Following a few more experiments, Dr. Gables goes insane and assaults the researcher. Following this, the Foundation investigates Dr. Gables to find his original observations that proved his involvement in multiple incidents, as well as numorous logs documenting other Foundation personnel and a large amount of blackmail which he has been using to get away with his actions. This concludes with a notice of termination of Dr. Gables and the reassignment of the SCP project to another researcher.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The dynamics of the relationships between Foundation researchers as well as the covert workings of a researcher with their own agendas and goals.

Additional Notes: I'm scared that readers may lose interest before getting to the meat of the story which would take place in the experiment logs and other attached documents.

item.title: Greenlight request- Frozen Corpse and Nervous System
item.description: First SCP attempt, with audio file attachment. Bisected corpse found dead with lower half moving on its own, possibly with a purpose or cognition.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror (body horror)

Page Layout (Optional): Class, containment procedures, description, addenda (including a voiceover mp3 file with sound effects)

Elevator Pitch: Pregnant woman is found frozen in the arctic, torn in half, fetus missing. Top half of body is dead, lower half moves erratically on its own, possibly with a purpose or cognition.

Central Narrative: Corpse was found frozen in Yukon when villagers noticed a strange, unidentified creature moving erratically. Corpse's lower half is controlled by a series of live neurons that consume the bone and ligament tissue and shock the muscles into moving convulsively, allowing it to crawl. It will violently hyperextend its joints (bending knees backwards and such) and break its own bones to move. The live neuron DNA matches the dead woman, whose brain is somewhat shrunken, or possibly her fetus. Lead scientist believes it's capable of navigation and is searching for something, but regrets that its lifespan is so short as a result of consuming its own flesh and progressively deflating in size, that they'll never know what it wants. It must remain frozen to stay alive until the foundation finds a way to save it or find what it's looking for.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Using body horror as a focus, of which I haven't seen much here, and a full story with open-ended conclusion that is coherent with beginning, middle, and end if the reader reads between the lines. Specifically, I'd like to include a voiceover file from the scientist's observation session with written transcript, recording the skittering and cracking noises the skip makes, with a subtle hint/easter egg for readers to listen for, revealing what it's capable of, and possibly answering the question of what it actually wants (this won't be included in the transcript, so that the reader is left to think and interpret it on their own).

Additional Notes: Please advise how to include the mp3 file with submission, as it's essential to the storytelling, thanks.

item.title: The Mother of a Hell-Spawn Goat Fetus
item.description: A humanoid goat that, when killed, explodes a goat fetus that will wreak havoc until neutralized.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch

  • A talking goat, that when alive, will cause a humanoid resembling a hunter to appear nearby.
  • The hunter will get to the goat through any means necessary, minus violence, and will kill the goat.
  • When the goat is dead, it will explode and a flying goat fetus will emerge.

Central Narrative:
Reports of a man wearing a goat costume and walking around a forest are being made. The Foundation brushes it off until reports of a flying baby that is shooting are made.

The foundation sends a Mobile Task Force to retrieve and detain SCP-XXXX (the goat) and SCP-XXXX-1 (flying goat fetus).

SCP-XXXX cooperates with Foundation personnel whereas SCP-XXXX-1 does not cooperate. Foundation Personnel request to neutralize SCP-XXXX-1 and the request is approved.

A hunter appears outside of Site [REDACTED] and asks politely to enter. When personnel guarding Site [REDACTED] refuse to let the hunter in, it uses its supernatural abilities of politeness to force the personnel to let it in.

The hunter makes its way to SCP-XXXX and reaches into a black duffel bag it is holding. The hunter pulls out a Semi-Automatic Shotgun and shoots SCP-XXXX until SCP-XXXX is dead. The hunter then disappears.

A few minutes SCP-XXXX begins to boil and then explodes. Approximately 17 seconds after SCP-XXXX has exploded, SCP-XXXX-1 emerges.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: SCP-XXXX-1 has DNA which may relate to the Scarlet King.

Additional Notes

  • When it says [REDACTED] after site, that is supposed to be blacked out text, I just don't know how to do that.
  • This is my first time writing a proposal so any feedback on how to better word this or anything that should be added/removed would be greatly appreciated.

item.title: SCP Idea: "Albularyo" (Seeking Greenlight)
item.description: An "Albularyo" is a healer that uses unconventional medicinal techniques. But this SCP idea in particular is a lot more different, of course.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: YES

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): The basic SCP article layout.

Elevator Pitch:

  • Nato Caluag is an "albularyo", roughly translates to "witch doctor" in english who can conjure instances of "Engkantos" a Filipino mythological creature capable of applying a "sumpa" or curse.
  • This SCP is contained in a cell where he cannot have access to any object that could possibly have been marked with someone's DNA or even fingerprint. A microphone hidden from this SCP's sight must always be present inside his cell.
  • Moreover, any form of media that could potentially contain piece of a person's identity can never be shown to this SCP.
  • As long as this Albularyo sees a person of interest, obtain a piece of their DNA or even acquire an object with that person's fingerprint, if this SCP is in a hostile mood, he will have a "conversation" with an "Engkanto" who he claims to be his best friend and command it to lay a "sumpa" on the chosen victim. (This is why the microphone is necessary, because he verbally converses out loud.)
  • The random victim will experience immense pain on random parts of the body (chosen by Nato) and orifices of the victim will slowly discharge tadpoles and prematurely born insects.
  • Victims of this SCP can never die from the curse. However, the "sumpa" is able to be cured. Just not in a medical sense.
  • Scientific way of cure like medicine or surgery can NEVER prevent the "sumpa". BUT the only way to cure it is to take the victim to another "albularyo" who can perform the ritual of curse-removal.
  • To avoid this hostile activity, a full rosary and the "divine mercy" ritual must sincerely be recited every 3 in the afternoon. (Priests are usually called to perform the procedure and applied with memetics after)

Central Narrative:
Nato Caluag was considered a vengeful and hateful albularyo. Coincidentally, he was also a powerful one. Able to easily conjure Engkantos (who were actually the enemies of the witch doctors).
In the provinces of The Philippines, albularyos are considered healers and able to remove curses from victims. But Nato was the opposite of this and would apply the curse with the help of his "friend", an "Engkanto" that he met when he was young.
Nato grabbed the attention of the foundation after consecutive cases of unexplainable diseases were reported in the province of Bulacan.
Nato is actually the elder brother of Ed Caluag, a famous paranormal expert in Filipino mainstream media, but when the foundation took him, memetics were given to Ed and his family, completely forgetting his existence.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:

  • Explores the pseudo-science belief of Filipino culture, especially the "albularyos" and "engkantos" with a unique take
  • This SCP can talk to engkantos and demand them to apply a curse ("sumpa") on a human, but this will never kill them, only make them suffer. And the only way to cure the curse is to find another albularyo capable of removing the curse.
  • Affiliation with a famous Filipino icon, but since he was taken by the foundation, his existence is not known to the public.

Additional Notes:

  • I'd gladly accept your critique on this and what should be improved.
  • I'd just like to know whether this idea is similar to an already-existing SCP or even tale?

item.title: A very long story about a spider and three goons
item.description: An exploration in two layers. On one level, The Chaos Insurgency and what it stands for. On another, loss and how we respond to it.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: No

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama action

Page Layout (Optional): N/A

Elevator Pitch: A single spider causes all genetic brain diseases. One woman wants to kill it for taking away her daughter, one man wants to protect it because he wants it to be studied, one girl just wants to be at peace and to succumb to it. An exploration in two layers. On one level, The Chaos Insurgency and what it stands for. On another, loss and how we respond to it.

Central Narrative: Two doctors are employed by The Foundation to research the source of all memory loss and neurodegenerative disease, a big spider. Elizabeth, loses her daughter to a brain disease. Kenneth sees The Foundation using the SCP as a weapon. Elizabeth and Kenneth defect from The Foundation to join the Chaos Insurgency. Now free from direct oversight, Elizabeth decides to kill the spider in revenge. Kenneth wants to capture and study the spider, wanting to prevent The Foundation or other groups from utilizing it for their own ends. Jacquelyn, a student of Elizabeth who was left with The Foundation when Liz defected, half-heartedly pursues the insurgents because she wants to speak with Elizabeth.

What each character represents:
Elizabeth:
- The Insurgency that wants to make the world better with anomalies.
- A self-destructive spite toward the thing that took away her daughter.
- Wins in the end. Destroys the SCP, ridding the world of the force that killed her daughter. To her, the SCP doesn't simply represent neurological diseases. Instead, to Elizabeth - and the audience - it's a stand-in for death.

Kenneth:
- The Insurgency that's simply trying to be a better version of The Foundation.
- A belief that death, even tragic death, is a part of life and should be accepted.
- Ultimately betrayed by Elizabeth and killed while attempting to stop her.

Jacquelyn:
- Simple apathy. The victim of the story, abandoned by Elizabeth and caught in the crossfire.
- Has an opportunity to stop Elizabeth. Doesn't, choosing to simply euthanise herself with happy memories excreted by the SCP.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: need help with this one

Additional Notes: Might be too melodramatic of a plot.

item.title: Ever Upwards
item.description: Humanity's desire to escape the atmosphere and explore space has a sinister and unknown motive
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Existential thriller, mystery

Elevator Pitch:
+ Elevator Pitch
- Elevator Pitch

This scp is, in a sense, humanity's seeming desire to leave earth's atmosphere and explore outer space. This scp was discovered once the foundation began to notice strange patterns in the direction and movement of every human and manmade object launched into space, as well as every other object in space (planets, stars, etc), which all appear to be converging to an unknown spot in spacetime at irregular speeds.

Central Narrative:
+ Central Narrative
- Central Narrative

While investigating several other space related anomalies, the foundation begins to put together a strange pattern in the movement of every object that has been launched into space, which all eventually begin to travel in the same exact direction. Digging further, they find a cut section of the Apollo 11 landing, during which mike collins seems to jump and be dragged out in this exact same direction for a few seconds, contrary to the observed gravitational effects of the moon. Curiously, satelites in orbit around earth such as the ISS are unaffected, as well as celestial bodies such as the planets, moons, and sun. However, calculations run by the foundation indicate that these bodies only appear to be unaffected, and have actually been moving in an even pace to one another in this direction for a while. Finally, the foundation uncovers that, over the course of millenia, every object in the universe has been traveling towards a single undefined point in space.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
+ Hook/Attention Grabber
- Hook/Attention Grabber

After running some tests, the foundation manages to calculate the coordinates for this point. After a predictably long journey, they finally manage to send a ship to the coordinates, which finds a barely describable fold in spacetime where all things are seemingly erased. Ordered to return, the unmanned ship curiously defies its controls and moves towards the fold, and strong radio interference is heard as the ship displays a white void. The foundation finds the sounds to be their only lead, and work to decipher a potential meaning. Although they fail, an incident occurs where these sounds are heard again from the sky, this time being mysteriously comprehensible, with the message:
"You have protected your world
from a great many threats,
from those which are incomprehensible,
and for that I am proud.
But what comes now you are not prepared for,
nor am I,
so I must protect you now,
within my unwavering.
Join me,
In this void,
and travel ever upward,
for you have no other choice"

The article ends with a question: If after all the foundation has fought, this void only interferes now, then what exactly is coming for us?

Additional Notes: Hope this isn't too similar to anything else and that it's interesting!

item.title: Seeking Critique (Love Potion No. 9)
item.description: I thought this would be a good idea for an SCP. Critiques are welcome and necessary :)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Comedy

Elevator Pitch: This is an SCP based upon the narrative created by the song, Love Potion No. 9, made popular by The Clovers in 1959. The premise is that the SCP is the actual love potion described in the song, more or less. The object itself is a safe object, characterized as being an opaque black liquid contained within a small glass bottle. The liquid itself is described as smelling of turpentine. Its anomalous property is that it causes the drinker to lose all romantic and sexual discretion, except for a marked increase in the attractiveness of members of law enforcement.

Central Narrative: This object came to the attention of the Foundation after a young man was arrested and brought to a mental asylum after falling under the effects of the love potion and succeeding in his attempt to passionately kiss a police officer on patrol. The young man informed officials that he was compelled to behave in that manner after drinking a potion, created by a gypsy fortune teller named Madame Ruth in order to cure him of his bad luck with women.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This is an SCP based on a well known piece of pop culture history. I feel like people will find it quite amusing and maybe even humorous.

Additional Notes: I hope you guys see this as a lighthearted, humorous attempt at an SCP article.

item.title: SCP Idea - A house and its occupant
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Currently unknown. Not sure what to categorize this SCP's genre.

Page Layout (Optional): Image, containment procedures, description, diary/interviews/addenda

Elevator Pitch: 2 anomalous entities designated SCP-XXXX-A and B. XXXX-A is a middle-aged woman living inside the house, who can summon any object upon request, usually in a similar manner to "Mom, can you find XYZ for me?". XXXX-B is a house, in which objects not belonging to direct family members (children and significant other) placed in it vanish after a couple hours.

Central Narrative: (will be told from a first person perspective of XXXX-A, from a diary, as well as interviews with Foundation personnel) The woman first discovers her powers on accident, and over the course of a couple years, discovers both the extent and limitations of her anomalous abilities, as well as trying to explore the limit of the alternate dimension from which she can summon objects. The diary follows the woman's (Claudia) life as she begins to adapt to being an anomaly, as well as being introduced to the Foundation, with whom Claudia cooperates with willingly, but under certain rules: she must keep her children and husband, and her day-to-day life must not be interrupted constantly; in return, she performs tests with the Foundation, and consents to being amnesticized after tests, in order to not spread Foundation information.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Description of SCP told from perspective of a burglar. XXXX-B summons human leg bones covered in old, decayed flesh, as well as an unknown fluid.

Additional Notes: I want to use the addendum section to insert this diary, but also slip in some references to the woman's background in the description. This SCP is a horror styled version of the cliche "Mom, I can't find XYZ" and your mom is the only one who can find the object in the house. I have made some changes here in this post as requested by Savanac, however, some of the changes requested are planned to be written and explained in the article.

item.title: ClicheFinder™
item.description: Finds cliches and gives owie effect. [thread locked, overflow]
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article (ACS)

Genre: meta

Elevator Pitch:

An unbranded notebook. When a description, name, or information is written on the 57th page of the notebook, the notebook then proceeds to display the "cliche-ness" of such information.
